item.title: Rdatasets Archive: 3400 free and documented datasets for fun and exploration
item.description:
🚨 Big milestone for Rdatasets 🚨
The web archive now hosts 3400+ free and documented datasets in CSV format. It's a fantastic resource for exploration, teaching, and testing!
The archive itself is language-agnostic. Anyone can download and search datasets from the website.
{Rdatasets} is a new [\#RStats](https://bsky.app/hashtag/RStats) 📦 for easy download and search
Web archive: [vincentarelbundock.github.io/Rdatasets](https://vincentarelbundock.github.io/Rdatasets)
R 📦: [vincentarelbundock.github.io/Rdatasetspkg](https://vincentarelbundock.github.io/Rdatasetspkg)
